name: Counterstrike
description: Being hit by an attack provokes an immediate counter-attack, dealing %damage_reduction:pct%% less damage but healing this unit for %lifesteal:pct%% of what it deals.

upgrade.summary: The counter deals %damage_bonus:pct%% more damage rather than less.
upgrade.description: Being hit by an attack provokes an immediate counter-attack, dealing %damage_bonus:pct%% MORE damage and healing this unit for %lifesteal:pct%% of what it deals.
details: The penalty is not merely lifted but reversed - a counter now hits harder than the swing that provoked it.
